test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In July 2021, Rakesh Asthana was appointed to which of the following posts?

options.text: Vice Chief of the Indian Navy
Director General of National Investigation Agency

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Commissioner of Delhi police**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Director-General of Border Security Force Rakesh Asthana__ has been appointed as Commissioner of Delhi Police.
 
• Mr. S. S. Deswal, Director General of Indo-Tibetan Border Police will hold additional charge of the post of DG, Border Security Force.
 
• The government had given additional charge of Delhi Police to Balaji Srivastava after the retirement of S. N. Shrivastava on **30 June 2021.**
